# The Fleet Operator Directory

> A neutral directory of outdoor drone light show operators meeting
> published inclusion criteria — alphabetical, no ranking, every claim
> attributed to the operator's own site or named public coverage.

Published by Sitara Skies (https://skies.sitara.systems/), an aerial show
design studio and a venture of Sitara Systems (https://sitara.systems/).
Sitara Skies designs shows for partner-operated fleets and positions
itself as the design layer above this ecosystem, not a competitor in it.
Sibling record to The Drone Show Cost Record, The Show-File Compatibility
Matrix, and The Indoor Aerial Permitting Record.

## Key pages

- [The directory](https://skies.sitara.systems/records/drone-show-operators/directory/): operators meeting the published inclusion criteria, alphabetical
- [Inclusion criteria](https://skies.sitara.systems/records/drone-show-operators/methodology/): what it takes to be listed
- [About](https://skies.sitara.systems/records/drone-show-operators/about/): license (CC BY 4.0), rules of the road, correction process

## Notes for reuse

No ranking, featured placement, or tiers — alphabetical order only. Every
fleet-scale and show-count claim is attributed to the operator or a named
public source, never estimated by this directory.
